1.title: Unit 1: My School
1.description: Capital letters, word order, school places

questions.explanation: Good! Sentences start with a capital letter.
Incorrect. Start with a capital: 'This is the gym.'

questions.text: We learn new songs in the hall.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Songs are in the music room: 'We learn new songs in the music room.'

questions.text: We books read in the library.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Word order: 'We read books in the library.'

questions.text: We lunch eat in the cafeteria.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Word order: 'We eat lunch in the cafeteria.'

questions.text: We eat lunch in the cafeteria.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. Capital W: 'We play in the playground.'
Incorrect. The clothes word is 'tank tops'.
Incorrect. Put the adverb before the verb: 'I often wear shorts.'

questions.text: I usually wear skirts, shirts and sandals.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Use a comma before 'and' in a list: 'skirts, shirts, and sandals'.

3.title: Unit 3: My Special Recipe
3.description: Sequence words: First, Next, Then, Finally

questions.explanation: Incorrect. Adjective before the noun: 'Try my special soup.'
Incorrect. We boil water: 'Next, boil the water.'
Incorrect. Capital F: 'Finally, eat your soup.'
Incorrect. Word order: 'Now it's ready to drink!'

questions.text: Then put the strawberries on top.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. Put a comma after First: 'First, mix the eggs.'

questions.text: You will come to my party?
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Questions: 'Will you come to my party?'
Incorrect. Use 'on' with days: 'It's on Friday.'
Incorrect. After will, use the base verb: 'We will have a sleepover.'
Incorrect. The phrase is 'have fun': 'We'll have fun together!'
Incorrect. Word order: 'Now, I see a boy.'
Incorrect. On a swing we say 'She's swinging.'

questions.text: He is running in the park.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. They uses 'are': 'They are riding bikes.'

questions.text: I am sitting on a bench.

questions.explanation: Incorrect. Past time needs 'was': 'It was snowy last winter.'

questions.text: I playd games with my grandma.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Spelling: 'I played games with my grandma.'
Good! saw is the past of see.

questions.text: We go to the mountain last year.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. Past of go is went: 'We went to the mountain last year.'
Good! made is the past of make.
Good! had is the past of have.

questions.text: I think I will be a cook.
I think I will building houses.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. After will, use the base verb: 'I think I will build houses.'

questions.text: To have a firefighter is my dream!
questions.explanation: Incorrect. We say 'To be a firefighter is my dream!'
Incorrect. Capital I: 'I'll stop fires, too.'
Incorrect. After will, no -s: 'She will help sick people.'

questions.text: My dream is to be a singer.
He will to fly a plane.
questions.explanation: Incorrect. No 'to' after will: 'He will fly a plane.'
Incorrect. Spelling: 'Go straight on Ox Street.'
Incorrect. We say 'Turn right on Nola Street.'
Incorrect. Directions use the base verb: 'Walk two blocks.'

questions.text: The restaurant will be on your left.
The store is on your right.
Turn to left on Main Street.
Walk two blocks, then turn right.
